collections.author: Kenney
collections.name: Impact Sounds
collections.note: The contact layer for four of the six materials. Metal, plate and tin for metal; wood and plank for wood; soft for dirt; mining for stone and dirt. Close-mic'd and dry, which is what a contact layer wants.

collections.author: rubberduck
collections.name: 100 CC0 metal and wood SFX
collections.note: Wood with more body than Kenney's, and the cracking and breaking a struck plank answers with.

collections.author: rubberduck
collections.name: 75 CC0 breaking / falling / hit SFX
collections.note: Debris. The archive creature_foley_generator and aircraft_spacecraft_generator both vetted; its SHA-256 was re-verified against a fresh download here too.

collections.author: rubberduck
collections.name: 40 CC0 water / splash / slime SFX
collections.note: The water column, which nothing else on this machine had. The slime is the wet layer under a flesh impact -- its author recorded it from real slime, which is exactly the kind of thing no oscillator gets to.

collections.author: Independent.nu
collections.name: 37 hits/punches
collections.note: The flesh column. The archive holds 37 hits; these six are unarmed_foley_generator's selection -- the low-end-heaviest of the set, measured by spectral balance from the onset and signed off by ear there. Re-extracted from the archive here rather than copied, and the archive's SHA-256 matches the one that generator recorded.

generators/projectile_sounds/sources/pro.conversion: Decoded with FFmpeg to mono 44100 Hz signed 16-bit PCM WAV; no content processing was applied to the bundled source files.

excluded.name: Car tire squeal skid loop
excluded.reason: CC-BY 3.0, not CC0. Reads as CC0-adjacent in search results, which is why licences are read on the page.

excluded.name: Punches, hits, swords and squishes
excluded.reason: CC-BY-SA 3.0 over mixed CC-BY/CC0 upstreams. Fails the CC0-only policy twice over. It is also the pack whose name most invites reaching for it; unarmed_foley_generator rejected it first, on the same grounds.

excluded.name: Freesound generally
excluded.reason: Per-sound licensing mixes CC0, CC-BY and Sampling+. Nothing there may be assumed CC0 without reading its own page.

generators/projectile_sounds/sources/pro.lossy_at_source: The Independent.nu hits are FLAC wrapped around already-MP3 audio, so they carry MP3 artefacts no re-encode can remove. Kept anyway, by ear, exactly as unarmed_foley_generator kept them.

shared_source_bank.ownership: General rubberduck wood contact, cracking, falling, slam, breaking, and hit recordings are owned by the material generator. Projectile-specific Kenney impactWood light/medium/heavy masters remain local to projectile_sounds.

generators/projectile_sounds/sources/pro.verification: Every collection's license was read on its own source page rather than from search results, and every archive was downloaded here and its SHA-256 recorded from the bytes received. The 32 rubberduck wood files named in shared_source_bank are resolved from the byte-identical wood_noise_generator bank instead of being stored twice.

effects.statement: Procedurally synthesised or built from the approved CC0/public-domain recordings enumerated in this ledger.

score.prompt: Original instrumental video-game soundtrack suite for a dry, deadpan suburban tower-defense game in which the residents of a quiet cul-de-sac defend their block against an advancing autonomous machine army. Warm late-evening neighborhood mood set against a cold mechanical undercurrent: muted electric piano, brushed kit, upright bass and a small recurring three-note doorbell motif on the warm side; a patient analog pad, a slow detuned drone and dry metallic percussion on the cold side, gradually taking more of the mix. Moderate 96 BPM in A minor, shifting to a driving 112 BPM section and one heavy low-brass and timpani passage for a final confrontation, then a bright resolving passage. Designed as seamless background music: immediate musical opening, steady energy, no long intro, no finale or fade, no vocals, no lyrics, and no sound effects. Distinct calm-preparation, steady-defense, high-pressure, and triumphant passages within one cohesive suite.
score.statement: Original instrumental generated from a project-authored prompt. No reference audio, lyrics, vocals or quoted commercial melody was supplied. This is a provenance record, not a legal opinion.
